parameters.name: Input Directory
parameters.description: Path to the directory containing data files (.h5, .tif, .tiff)

parameters.name: Result Directory
parameters.description: Path to the directory where results will be saved

parameters.name: Remove Lines
parameters.help_text: Removes first few horizontal scan lines of noise, if needed

parameters.name: 2x Downsampling Factor
parameters.description: Log base 2 of the temporal downsampling factor (default: 1, means 2^1 = 2x downsampling)

parameters.name: Frame Rate
parameters.description: Frame rate in Hz (default: 0 for auto-detect)

parameters.name: Save Tif?
parameters.description: Save motion corrected movie as a tif?

parameters.name: dXY
parameters.help_text: how large sources can be (radius), pixels

parameters.name: photonScale
parameters.help_text: roughly the single-photon amplitude. Leave empty to use default/estimate from data.

parameters.name: sigma_px
parameters.help_text: Estimated radius of the PSF (gaussian sigma)

parameters.name: nmfIter
parameters.help_text: number of iterations of NMF refinement

parameters.name: phi
parameters.help_text: parameter for how much to relax L1 regularization during debiasing (0=no regularization, 1=full regularization)

parameters.name: denoiseWindow_s
parameters.help_text: the timescale on which signals can be smoothed when denoising, seconds

parameters.name: baselineWindow_Glu_s
parameters.help_text: timescale for calculating F0 in glutamate channel, seconds

parameters.name: baselineWindow_Ca_s
parameters.help_text: timescale for calculating F0 in second channel, seconds (if applicable, typically for simultaneous Glu + Ca imaging)

parameters.name: activityChannel
parameters.help_text: the channel of the original tiff image that contains the glutamate signal

parameters.name: tau_s
parameters.help_text: decay time constant of glutamate signal

parameters.name: tau2_s
parameters.help_text: decay time constant of 2nd channel signal at synapses (usually spine calcium)

parameters.name: VIF
parameters.help_text: variance inflation factor for stdIM estimate

parameters.name: minPeakDistance
parameters.help_text: minimum Chebyshev distance between peaks (pixels); 1 = adjacent peaks allowed

parameters.name: motionThresh
parameters.help_text: decrease this to be more stringent on motion correction when censoring frames

parameters.name: nanThresh
parameters.help_text: Max fraction of samples that can be NaN for including a pixel in analysis

parameters.name: discardInitial_s
parameters.help_text: time in seconds to remove from analysis at the start of each trial, to account for warmup
